manifest.name: Village Polls
installationSteps: Turn on Village Polls and keep the default command prefix and names for the easiest setup.
Keep platform chat triggers on the main THSV intake actions; no separate poll commands or triggers are required in Streamer.bot.
Restart StreamBridge after saving the add-on settings.
Open and close one test poll, confirm announcements reach the supported chats, and add the Village Polls browser source when result cards should appear on stream.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling preserves the current poll definition and private vote state.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded universal poll state, private hashed cross-platform voting, chat announcements, source confirmations, and result-overlay output are available.
